title: A second rectangle is not called Rectangle
goal: Every new layer of a kind gets the same name, so a document ends up with three layers all called Rectangle and lists that name them cannot tell them apart. New layers should get a number when the name is already taken.
notes: Found while building the group override list (2026-09-03): the list named two pieces Rectangle and Rectangle and there was no way to tell which was which without clicking. Layer naming happens where new layers are made in EditorState; the Layers list has the same problem.
acceptance: Drawing a second rectangle names it Rectangle 2, not Rectangle
A name already in use anywhere in the document counts as taken
Renaming a layer by hand is never renumbered afterwards
